name: gate
purpose: Pre-gate every proposed action BEFORE it is shown to the operator: the first checker in the maker/checker pipeline. Advisory only — explicit operator approval remains mandatory for every apply, and Jev never executes anything.
state_template: FINDING: <kind, rank, evidence summary>. PROPOSED ACTION: <name from the ACTIONS allowlist, target, witness>. DRY-RUN PREVIEW: <exactly what it will do>. UNDO: <verified undo>. CONTEXT: <anything that affects blast radius>.

matches_finding.instructions: Does the proposed action directly and narrowly address the finding?

scope_risk.instructions: How risky is the blast radius of this action?
criteria: Broader than needed but still reversible

gate.instructions: What should the actuation pipeline do?

criteria.refuse: Do not proceed — wrong action or too broad
criteria.dry_run_only: Show the operator a dry-run, do not queue for approval

policy.note: gate=ready still requires explicit operator approval with the dry-run shown first. Record the gate verdict and confidence in the journal reason.
